title: King Tide Fishing Charters
specs: Fast access to fishing grounds within 10 minutes from private dock
Targets salmon, halibut, lingcod, rockfish in Juan de Fuca Strait
Vessels Transport Canada certified with heated cabins and marine toilets on larger boats
All guests must pre-purchase a DFO Tidal Waters Sport Fishing Licence online before arrival, including Pacific Salmon Conservation Stamp if retaining salmon
Transport Canada Master Certification and Marine First Aid held by all captains
No age, weight, or health restrictions stated
Fleet accommodates groups up to 18 guests with multi-boat coordination for large parties
includes: All necessary fishing equipment and tackle including premium rods, Islander reels, and Scotty downriggers
Catch cleaning, professional filleting, and heavy-duty bagging at private dockside cleaning station
On-board private marine toilets and fully enclosed heated cabins on 24' River Hawk and 28' Northwest vessels
Use of elite technology like Lowrance ActiveTarget HD Sonar
blurb: King Tide Fishing Charters offers half-day, full-day, multi-day, and dusk fishing charters targeting salmon, halibut, lingcod, and rockfish. Trips depart from a private dock in Sooke, BC, with fast access to local fishing grounds. They also offer wildlife and coastal explorer charters for families and photographers.
extraNote: 15% deposit required to secure booking, balance due on day of expedition · Cancellations free up to 3 days prior for 22' Whaler and 24' River Hawk, 7 days prior for 28' Northwest; later cancellations forfeit deposit · Weather cancellations at Captain's discretion with full refund or reschedule option · Captain may terminate charter without refund for intoxication or unsafe behavior · No catch guarantee; maximum effort and professional execution guaranteed · Private dock in Sooke, BC · April through December (varies by vessel and trip)
